name: Domestic worker sponsorship (Musaned)

requirements.blocker_text: Secondary sources report a minimum sponsor age of 24 for unmarried applicants specifically, per a Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development eligibility rule -- this figure could not be independently confirmed against a directly-fetched hrsd.gov.sa or Musaned page in this research pass, so it is treated as informational rather than a confirmed hard cutoff.

Requires an active Musaned account (accessed via Absher/Nafath) -- Musaned is confirmed as HRSD's official, mandatory platform for this service (free of charge, 24-hour processing) directly on hrsd.gov.sa. Household eligibility further limits the number of workers a single household can sponsor based on family size and declared income.
requirements.fix_path: Register an active Musaned account and confirm household eligibility for the requested worker category.

requirements.blocker_text: Recruitment is restricted to approved private-household job categories (housemaid, private driver, cook, caregiver, nanny, and similar) under HRSD's domestic-workers regulation; it is legally distinct from corporate work-visa sponsorship and cannot be used to hire staff for a business.
requirements.fix_path: Use the standard Employment Visa route for business hiring instead.

evidence_required.document: Active Musaned account linked to Absher and Nafath
Signed e-contract and e-Tawtheeq (contract attestation) via the Musaned platform
Registered housing contract in the sponsor's name

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's household registration, renewed via Musaned

sources.title: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (hrsd.gov.sa) -- Request to issue a domestic worker visa electronically, confirming Musaned as HRSD's official platform for this service, free of charge with 24-hour processing
Wego Travel Blog -- How Musaned Works in 2026, describing HRSD's official domestic-worker recruitment platform functions
Gulf News -- reporting the government-stated minimum sponsor age of 24 for domestic-worker hiring via Musaned
LabourBooking -- Domestic Worker Visa & Sponsorship in Saudi Arabia 2026 Guide, describing the household-vs-corporate sponsorship distinction and approved job categories

notes: SOURCING UPGRADE: hrsd.gov.sa was successfully fetched directly in this research pass (unlike pr.gov.sa, which blocks automated access) and confirms Musaned as HRSD's official, mandatory, free-of-charge platform for domestic-worker visa issuance -- a genuine tier-1 basis for the platform-mechanism and job-category facts in this route. The specific age-24 sponsor-minimum figure, however, remains tier-3-sourced only (Gulf News reporting, corroborated by an Arabic-language secondary aggregator) and could not be independently confirmed against a directly-fetched HRSD eligibility page in this pass -- modeled as hard:false rather than forced onto a tier-1 citation it doesn't have, the same honest-modeling choice used elsewhere in this build (sa_asylum, sa_premium_residency_general's talent-salary figure) rather than either inventing a citation or discarding a plausible, specific, widely-reported fact. This route is structurally distinct from sa_family_sponsorship despite sharing the 'family' category: it sponsors a worker into the household rather than a family member, doesn't lead anywhere in the route graph (switchable_to is empty), and the worker's own status is entirely dependent on and terminable by the sponsoring household -- worth surfacing clearly on any UI distinguishing 'family' routes that bring relatives in from this route, which brings in someone to work for the family instead. From 1 January 2026, HRSD mandated that all domestic-worker salaries be paid through Musaned's electronic wage-protection system, and a new Work Interruption service went live -- both confirmed via the Wego Travel source and worth surfacing as a recent regulatory tightening.
